channel.description: Latest articles from The Real News (therealnews.com)

item.title: Texas’ one-of-a-kind concentration camp for children and families
item.description: “I seriously think we're going to remember it like Dachau or something. I think it's going to be one of those names that just sends a shiver down your spine when you hear it.”

item.title: US-backed killing of cartel boss unleashes wave of violence across Mexico
item.description: The killing of Mexico’s top cartel leader, known as “El Mencho,” has created a power struggle that “could plunge Mexico into almost record levels of violence,” said one expert.

item.title: Manifest Destiny never ended: the domestic war for white supremacy
item.description: The US operates in a perpetual state of internal war, and the white supremacist legacy of domestic warfare has reached terrifying new heights in the Trump era, says scholar and author Dylan Rodríguez.

item.title: Trump admits war would be disastrous for ordinary Iranians as he weighs military assault
item.description: “The stakes are clear,” said the National Iranian American Council. “There’s a chance to avert war and disastrous outcomes for the people of Iran, but time may be running out.”

item.title: ‘We have to burn down the world.’ Will Europe follow Trump and the US into the geopolitical abyss?
item.description: "Europeans are really reluctant to accept that, after 80 years, they are now on the outside. There's no collective hegemony with the US [anymore]."

item.title: Columbia University is doing Trump’s anti-constitutional dirty work
item.description: “We now have a system where the federal government will, by proxy, take away all of our rights through economic coercion of our private institutions.”

item.title: Jeremy Scahill: Prospects for avoiding US-Iran war ‘remain fragile’
item.description: “No doubt about it, we are on the brink of something potentially very bad happening, and the number of sane people in this administration is so tiny…”

item.title: DOJ under fire for withholding Epstein files related to alleged Trump child sex assault
item.description: “Covering up direct evidence of a potential assault by the president of the United States is the most serious possible crime in this White House,” said one Democratic congressman.

item.title: As Trump builds up to attack Iran, the Dem establishment—again—shows its support with silence
item.description: Feigned helplessness, process criticism, no public statements or editorials: Liberal elites continue to let Trump do their dirty work for them.

item.title: Jeffrey Sachs: After four years of war in Ukraine, the world order has changed dramatically
item.description: “The US thought, ‘We’re the hegemon, we’ll run the show.’ But, in fact, what we have is a bully in the United States—still very violent and very powerful, no doubt—and a vassal Europe that is utterly confused, demoralized, and divided.”
